_note: Copied verbatim from frontend/src/pages/InfoPage.jsx and backend/orders/views.py. The shop keeps policies as static page text (not in the database), so if you change a policy on the website, change it here too.

topics.shipping: Standard delivery takes 5–7 working days across Pakistan. Express delivery (2–4 working days) is available at checkout. Orders above PKR 5,000 ship free.
topics.returns: Items can be returned within 14 days of delivery if unworn, unwashed, and with original tags attached. Start a return from My Account > Orders, selecting the item and a reason. Refunds are processed within 5–7 working days of approval.
topics.exchanges: Need a different size or color? Request an exchange from My Account > Orders within 14 days of delivery. Exchanges are subject to stock availability.
topics.payment: Payment methods: Cash on Delivery, Bank Transfer, and Card. Checkout as a guest is possible; no account is required.
topics.contact: Reach our customer care team at support@orelle.pk or call 0800-ORELLE, Monday to Saturday, 10am–7pm. We usually respond within one business day.
topics.size_guide: Refer to the Size Guide on each product page for garment-specific measurements. As a general rule: S fits 36" chest, M fits 38", L fits 40", XL fits 42".
topics.order_tracking: Track an order from the Track Order page using the order number and the email used at checkout, or from My Account > Orders when logged in.
